meta.description: QR in everywhere: attendance, feedback, menus and loyalty bonuses for business with a single QR code.

hero.subtitle: KasipQR is a platform for businesses in Kazakhstan. Turn on only the modules you need: staff attendance, guest feedback, QR menus and customer bonuses.

points.noHardware: No hardware: just a QR code

modules.title: Modules for your tasks
modules.subtitle: Each module is connected separately. Pay only for what you use.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Staff check in and out by scanning the location QR. Live log, geolocation check, automatic day close.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: Guests leave anonymous feedback via a QR on the table or counter. Statistics for every location.

menu.title: Menu
menu.description: QR menus for cafes and restaurants, plus calling a waiter to the table.

bonus.title: Bonuses
bonus.description: A loyalty program without cards: the cashier finds a customer by phone number, adds and redeems bonuses.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: From sign-up to the first scan in a few minutes.

register.title: Sign up
register.description: Create an account and add your organization: a company by BIN or a sole proprietor by IIN.

module.title: Pick a module
module.description: Connect the module you need. Attendance can be tried for free.

print.title: Print the QR
print.description: Print the location QR code and place it at the entrance, counter or table.

work.title: Get to work
work.description: Staff and customers scan the QR, and you see everything in the dashboard.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Monthly payment per module. Prices will be announced when modules launch.
pricing.attendanceNote: Try it for free, then pay monthly.
pricing.soonNote: The module is in development. We will let you know when it can be connected.

about.title: About
about.lead: KasipQR is built by the today.development team from Atyrau.
about.text: We build simple QR-based tools for business. One dashboard, one set of locations and QR codes, and modules do the work: attendance today, feedback, menus and bonuses tomorrow.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: Simplify everyday business processes: tracking, feedback and loyalty.

approach.title: Approach
approach.description: No training and no hardware: a phone and a printed QR are enough.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: QR in everywhere: one platform where each business connects exactly what it needs.

footer.description: Built by today.development. A QR-based platform for business: attendance, feedback, menus and bonuses.
